title: Browse the full self-tool inventory
notes: Returns every self-tool as {name, summary}. Cheap browse-the-surface call — use this when you're not sure which tool to reach for, then call tool_describe on the one you pick for the full schema + examples.

title: Find a tool by substring (matches name AND summary)
notes: Case-insensitive substring filter. Returns count:0 with an empty list when nothing matches — that's not an error, it's the agent's signal to widen the filter or call tool_describe on a guess.
